_comment: Trigger evaluation set. A skill that never fires is almost always a
description problem, and the only way to know is to test phrasings the
For each skill: should_trigger prompts must load it, and near_miss prompts
must not. Near misses share vocabulary with the skill but need something
else — they are what catch an over-broad description.
Run these by hand against a host after changing any description, then check
the transcript for the skill actually loading. skills/tests/test_eval.py
only validates that this file stays well-formed and covered.
